prompt: Who is the most recent female middle school student to represent China in the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) contest?
answer: The most recent was **Deng Leyan (邓乐言)**. She represented China at the **2025 IMO** as a first-year high-school student and won a **perfect-score gold medal**. She also returned to the Chinese team for the **2026 IMO**.
